facts.business: Cerebra Integrated Technologies Limited appears to be a technology company that previously engaged in refurbishment activities and had a subsidiary in Dubai (Cerebra Middle East FZCO), but has substantially reduced its workforce and ceased key operations.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Disclaimer of Opinion due to: (a) material uncertainty on going concern basis; (b) inventory devaluation of Rs. 9.76 Crore without supporting details; (c) loans/advances of Rs. 5.98 Crore to subsidiary with eroded net worth and no ECL provision; (d) trade receivables of Rs. 143.07 Crore with Rs. 142.99 Crore overdue >1 year and only Rs. 136.89 Crore provision on ad hoc basis; (e) overseas receivables of Rs. 100.28 Crore from sale of Dubai subsidiary overdue >2 years, no provision, not restated per Ind AS 21; (f) capital/other advances of Rs. 20.29 Crore outstanding >1 year, subject to confirmation, no provision.

key_risks: Material uncertainty on going concern due to significant operating losses, workforce reduction, cessation of key operations, and inability to meet obligations
Inventory devaluation of Rs. 9.76 Crore on ad hoc basis without item-wise details or supporting documents
Loans and advances of Rs. 5.98 Crore to subsidiary with completely eroded net worth, no expected credit loss provision
Trade receivables of Rs. 143.07 Crore with 99.9% overdue >1 year, provision of only Rs. 136.89 Crore on ad hoc basis, balances subject to confirmation
Overseas receivables of Rs. 100.28 Crore from sale of Dubai subsidiary overdue >2 years, no provision, not restated per Ind AS 21
Capital and other advances of Rs. 20.29 Crore outstanding >1 year, subject to confirmation, no provision for doubtful recovery
facts.related_party_note: Loans and advances include Rs. 5.98 Crore receivable from subsidiary Cerebra LPO India Limited outstanding >3 years; investment in equity shares of subsidiary (book value Rs. 0.035 Crore); receivable from sale of erstwhile subsidiary Cerebra Middle East FZCO Dubai of Rs. 100.28 Crore.
